comment: Recipe composition knowledge shared by build-catalog.mjs and LayoutEditorRecipeKnowledge.cs. recipes[]: id = recipe asset id (file name without extension); step = CookingSteps asset id, empty = no cooking; ingredients = leaf ingredient asset ids. skip[] lists runtime variants (score 0 optional/model assets) excluded from recipes.json. Recipes without an entry here and without statically parseable composition are skipped during generation.
